tokens.name: material
tokens.usage: Ground. The system material behind every window (Popover, Sidebar, Mica, Acrylic), as designs draw it over a desktop with blur 30 and saturate 180%. Code never draws it: the window is transparent and MyGo's Vibrancy shows the system's.

tokens.name: solid
tokens.usage: Ground. The window fill where no material shows (Linux, Windows 10, Reduce transparency). Page boards are drawn on it and the contrast audit is computed on it.

tokens.name: detail
tokens.usage: Region. The accounts window's detail region over the material.

tokens.name: solid-detail
tokens.usage: Region. The accounts window's detail region over solid.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Surface. Result cards, the identity list, settings groups, the drop zone, notices: one step lighter than the ground under it, with a 0.5 rim and a light top edge (shadow-card), so it reads on the sidebar, the detail region and the material alike.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Surface. Text inputs, drop-downs and text areas, with a line hairline.

tokens.name: menu
tokens.usage: Surface. System menus, dialog windows, tooltips and the undo bar as designs draw them (blur 36, saturate 200%). Code uses the system's own material for menus and dialogs.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Surface. The chosen segment of a segmented control and a switch's knob, with shadow-raised.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: State. A control at rest: secondary buttons, a segmented track, tags. MyGo Surface.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: State. Under the pointer: icon buttons and rows; over fill it is a secondary button's hover. MyGo SurfaceHover.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: State. The chosen row of the accounts sidebar and the chosen settings tab. Neutral, never the accent.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: State. Pressed. MyGo SurfacePressed.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Role. Mint: the one primary button, a switch that is on, a chosen radio or checkbox, text buttons, the drop highlight. MyGo Accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Role. A primary button under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Role. A pressed primary button.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Role. Text and glyphs on the accent. MyGo AccentText.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Role. The accent as a tint: the drop zone while a folder is dragged over it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Role. The focus ring: ring wide, 1 off the control, only from the keyboard.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Role. Selected text.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Text. Titles, names, body text, control labels.

tokens.name: fg2
tokens.usage: Text. The second step: values and the main line of a description.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Text. Emails, paths, hints, group headings, icon button glyphs.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Text. Placeholders and disabled labels; decoration only, never text that must be read.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Meaning. Errors: error text, error borders, error glyphs, the danger button.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Meaning. Text on the danger button.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Meaning. Under an error problem bar or banner.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Meaning. Warnings: glyphs, borders, status dots. Never body text.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Meaning. Under a warning problem bar.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Meaning. Success: the connected dot, the copied check, configuration in place.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Line. Hairlines: dividers, input borders, the drop zone's dashes.

tokens.name: id-blue
tokens.usage: Identity color: blue.

tokens.name: id-green
tokens.usage: Identity color: green.

tokens.name: id-orange
tokens.usage: Identity color: orange.

tokens.name: id-red
tokens.usage: Identity color: red.

tokens.name: id-purple
tokens.usage: Identity color: purple.

tokens.name: id-yellow
tokens.usage: Identity color: yellow (letters in id-ink-dark).

tokens.name: id-ink-light
tokens.usage: The letter on an identity badge, except yellow.

tokens.name: id-ink-dark
tokens.usage: The letter on a yellow identity badge.

tokens.name: logo-tile
tokens.usage: Logo. The app icon's graphite tile.

tokens.name: logo-folder
tokens.usage: Logo. The app icon's ivory folder.

tokens.name: logo-core
tokens.usage: Logo. The mint core lit inside the keyhole.

tokens.name: tray-ink
tokens.usage: Logo. The ink of the non-template tray icon (Windows, Linux). macOS uses a template image the system tints.

tokens.name: tray-warning
tokens.usage: Logo. The tray icon's warning mark.

tokens.name: tray-error
tokens.usage: Logo. The tray icon's error mark.

tokens.name: wallpaper
tokens.usage: Designs only: the sample wallpaper on desktop boards.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

type.note: Sizes at the macOS font size 13; on Windows and Linux the theme font size is 14 and every style scales with it (Style.On). Chinese takes the same size and a 2 taller line, no tracking.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The product name in the about window, and nowhere else.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Window and panel titles (the panel's Idset), the identity name in a result card and the editor, empty and error titles, the letter of a 32 badge.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Everything else, and the text inside controls: inputs, menus, values in a row.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Button labels, identity names in a list, form labels.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Dialog titles, the first line of a problem bar or notice, the letter of a 28 badge.

styles.name: secondary
styles.usage: Hints, emails, status lines, the drop zone's line, a problem bar's detail.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Group headings (Identities · 4), settings tab labels, small tags (Global, Scoped, New).

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Paths, aliases, commands, key names, beside body or secondary.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: The same beside small: the clone command, paths in a finding.

spacing.note: Multiples of Theme.Spacing (4 at default; 3 compact, 5 roomy), so density scales them. Values at default. Eight steps and nothing in between: 2 and 6 are the inline half steps, the rest multiples of 4. Code: t.Space(theme.Space3) and the rest.

tokens.name: space-0_5
tokens.usage: A name and its second line (stack-tight); a segmented track.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: An icon and small text; a menu's frame.

tokens.name: space-1_5
tokens.usage: An icon and its label (inline); inside a button.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Items of a row (item-row); lines of a card (stack).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding; the panel's content inset; between blocks of the panel (stack-block).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: A dialog's padding; between a dialog's sections (stack-section).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: A window pane's padding (inset-pane); between groups (stack-page).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Only for indent arithmetic.

radius.note: By role, not by size, in DIPs: radii do not follow density. A capsule or circle is half its height (radius-pill). Code: theme.RadiusCard and the rest.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small marks: checkboxes, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Rows and highlights in them: a row's hover and selected fill, menu entries, icon buttons, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Controls: text inputs, drop-downs, the 28 and 32 badges, problem bars, settings tabs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Surfaces: cards, list cards, groups, the drop zone, the 44 badge.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Windows and dialog windows as designs draw them; the system draws their corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsules and circles: buttons, segmented controls, switches, status dots, color choices. The theme Radius.

shadow.note: Glass casts almost no shadow: a card has only its rim and top edge; windows, menus and the chosen segment have one, and the system draws a window's.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A card's 0.5 rim and light top edge.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The chosen segment of a segmented control, a switch's knob.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: System menus, dialog windows, tooltips and the undo bar in designs.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Windows in designs; in code the system draws it.

size.note: Fixed sizes in DIPs at the default spacing; code takes them as steps of Theme.Spacing (t.Space(theme.Control)), so density scales them. A component takes its size from here, never a number of its own. A token with a unit is a line width, not a spacing step.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Control height: buttons, text inputs, drop-downs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-s
tokens.usage: Small control height: small buttons, icon buttons, menu entries.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: A glyph beside small text, a disclosure chevron.

tokens.name: icon-s
tokens.usage: A glyph in a row: findings, problem bars, menus.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: A glyph in a button or a title row.

tokens.name: icon-m
tokens.usage: A settings tab's glyph.

tokens.name: icon-l
tokens.usage: The glyph of an empty state or a result.

tokens.name: row-s
tokens.usage: A compact row: a finding, a file row, a time row.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: A plain row: a settings row of one line, a menu group.

tokens.name: row-l
tokens.usage: A row with a badge or a second line: a bind row, a sidebar row, a settings row, a form row.

tokens.name: row-list
tokens.usage: A row of the panel's identity list: a badge and two lines.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The panel's title row and footer.

tokens.name: bar-l
tokens.usage: The footer of the accounts and settings windows, the sidebar's footer.

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: The title bar of a window with one (designs only; the system draws it).

tokens.name: badge-s
tokens.usage: An identity badge in a list.

tokens.name: badge-m
tokens.usage: An identity badge in a result card.

tokens.name: badge-l
tokens.usage: The identity badge at the head of the editor; an empty state's glyph tile.

tokens.name: app-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon in the about window.

tokens.name: dot-s
tokens.usage: A connectivity dot.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: An identity's color dot: identities in a backup.

tokens.name: dot-l
tokens.usage: A color choice.

tokens.name: switch-w
tokens.usage: A switch's width.

tokens.name: switch-h
tokens.usage: A switch's height.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: A switch's knob.

tokens.name: check
tokens.usage: A checkbox or a radio.

tokens.name: label-w
tokens.usage: The label column of a form.

tokens.name: button-w
tokens.usage: The least width of grouped buttons (a dialog's, a footer's); buttons of a group share one width.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The accounts window's identity list.

tokens.name: tab-w
tokens.usage: A settings tab's width.

tokens.name: tab-h
tokens.usage: A settings tab's height.

tokens.name: pane-max
tokens.usage: The most a settings pane's content grows to, centered.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The widest a short run of secondary text grows before it wraps: a tooltip, an empty state's hint, the about window's note.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, input borders.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The focus ring's width.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: An emphasis border: an input in error, a card colored by severity, the drop zone's dashes.

tokens.name: countdown
tokens.usage: The undo bar's countdown line.

window.note: Window sizes in DIPs, fixed: the system scales them. Code: theme.PanelW and the rest.

tokens.name: dialog-w
tokens.usage: A dialog window; its height is its content's.

tokens.name: panel-w
tokens.usage: The panel window, fixed.

tokens.name: panel-h
tokens.usage: The panel window's height.

tokens.name: accounts-w
tokens.usage: The accounts window as it opens; resizable.

tokens.name: accounts-h
tokens.usage: The accounts window's height as it opens.

tokens.name: accounts-min-w
tokens.usage: The least the accounts window shrinks to.

tokens.name: accounts-min-h
tokens.usage: The least height of the accounts window.

tokens.name: settings-w
tokens.usage: The settings window as it opens; resizable.

tokens.name: settings-h
tokens.usage: The settings window's height as it opens.

tokens.name: settings-min-w
tokens.usage: The least the settings window shrinks to.

tokens.name: settings-min-h
tokens.usage: The least height of the settings window.

tokens.name: about-w
tokens.usage: The about window with its title bar, fixed.

tokens.name: about-h
tokens.usage: The about window's height with its title bar.

opacity.note: Opacity values come only from here.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A control that cannot be used, as a whole.

tokens.name: opacity-faded
tokens.usage: A form or list dimmed while its work runs: saving, importing, restoring.

motion.note: Motion only says where something came from, what happened, or look here; never decoration. Fixed durations on one curve, no springs; exits are faster than entries. Durations are time.Duration (theme.MotionBase), a distance is DIPs (theme.MotionShift), the curve is a ui.Easing (theme.Ease). Under reduced motion MyGo keeps only fades and color changes; nothing moves or collapses.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Exits, color changes, content swapped: the drop zone taking a folder, Copied, collapsing, a row removed.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Entries and expanding: the result card, the undo bar, diagnostics opening, a row added.

tokens.name: motion-shift
tokens.usage: How far a card or bar travels as it enters: the result card settles from above, the undo bar rises from below.

tokens.name: motion-ack
tokens.usage: How long Copied, Saved and Updated stay; a repeat starts it again.

tokens.name: motion-undo
tokens.usage: The undo bar's countdown, from an absolute deadline.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: The curve of every transition: quick out, slow to settle. No springs.

moments.name: drop-target
moments.trigger: A folder dragged over the panel
moments.moves: The drop zone's border and fill turn accent, and back when it leaves.
moments.call: theme.Recolor: Transition{Colors: true, Duration: MotionFast, Ease: Ease, Enter, Exit: &Motion{}}

moments.name: result-card
moments.moves: The drop zone fades out; the card settles from motion-shift above as it fades in; Clear fades it out.
moments.call: theme.Arrive(c, card, theme.Slide(-1), theme.Fade()): Transition{Position, Size, Enter: &Motion{Y: -MotionShift}, Exit: &Motion{}}

moments.name: undo-bar
moments.moves: The bar rises from motion-shift below as it fades in; the countdown line glides to empty by the deadline; the bar fades out when committed or undone.
moments.tokens: motion-base in, motion-fast out; the line motion-undo, linear
moments.call: theme.Arrive(c, bar, theme.Slide(1), theme.Fade()); the line AnimateWith(key, 0, remaining, ui.Linear)
moments.reducedMotion: The bar fades in place; the line steps each second.

moments.name: ack
moments.trigger: A path, public key or command copied; a write succeeded
moments.moves: The symbol cross-fades to a check mark and the word (Copied, Saved, Restored) fades in; both go back after motion-ack.
moments.call: theme.Swap: ContentTransition{Animation: &Animation{Duration: MotionFast, Ease: Ease}}; the word theme.FadeIn: Transition{Enter, Exit: &Motion{}}

moments.name: diagnostics
moments.moves: The details open along their height and the chevron turns down; closing reverses it.
moments.call: theme.Arrive(c, details, theme.Collapse(), theme.Collapse()); the chevron theme.Turn: AnimatePose(Pose{Rotate: 90})

moments.name: identity-rows
moments.trigger: An identity created, saved or deleted in the account window
moments.moves: A new row opens and fades in; a deleted row closes and fades out; the others move to their place. The tray panel's list does not move.

moments.name: editor
moments.moves: The editor's content fades in; nothing slides.

moments.name: windows
moments.trigger: The panel, a window, the delete confirmation or a menu opens
moments.moves: The system draws them; Idset adds no motion, and the panel's content does not move as it opens.

audit.note: The contrast audit. Text and meaning colors are checked on every ground a text can sit on, each stack laid alpha over alpha on solid or solid-detail. Change any color and run it again.
